newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn growers "committed" to ethanol.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn growers "committed" to ethanol.

text.p: The National Corn Growers Association (NCGA) Thursday threw its weight behind ethanol and said it would press the benefits of the ethanol tax incentive with the new 105th Congress.

"We are firmly committed to continuing an all-out effort to grow this important market for corn growers," NCGA president Wallie Hardie told reporters at a news conference to kick off a meeting of top U.S. soybean and corn growers.
Asked if the group's strategy was to keep the incentives until the year 2000 or to go beyond, Hardie said: "We're going to do the best we can to maintain the exemption as it is until 2000."
The tax incentive has come under fire from critics who say it amounts to a government hand-out.
